behavior: A popup root checks the popup, positioner and backdrop for the element whose animations end an open change. The shared popup store also supplies a held popup as a last choice (`VUE-137`). With no popup part, the positioner or backdrop can still finish its exit. The root then removes it or keeps it hidden. The root emits `openChangeComplete` with `true` one time after each open and with `false` one time after each close. A standalone Combobox or Autocomplete list with no positioner stays on the screen, so it ends no open change. A popup part that attaches after the open completion starts no second completion. In Base UI, the popup part reports the open completion. Its shared root waits for the popup ref by default. With just a positioner or a backdrop, that root reports no completion and keeps the parts mounted.
